messages:
riley.devex: weird parity bug in sampleapp onboarding: SDK sends query `dryRun=false` and backend treats string 'false' differently -> intermittent 401 on refresh + duplicate records.

maya.sdk: can you paste minimal repro?

riley.devex: curl (works):
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/onboard?lang=en' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"name":"foo"}'
```
SDK (fails sometimes):
```
await client.onboard({ name:'foo' }, { query:{ lang:'en', dryRun:false } })
```

sam.platform: server expects missing param == false; explicit 'false' triggers legacy branch that checks session cache and may return 401 mid-refresh.

maya.sdk: our serializer currently does String(value) for query params. We'll change to omit when value is false/null. Also we'll stop auto-retrying POSTs on 401 unless idempotency-key is present.

ci-bot: incident: 2 customers reported duplicate onboarding ids in last 12h, correlated with sdk v1.8.2.

riley.devex: action items: maya -> PR for serializer + retry tweak (ETA EOD). sam -> temporary middleware to treat 'false' like missing for onboarding endpoint (ETA today). I'll add a sampleapp integration test to catch this.

maya.sdk: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/501 (draft).
